01 / About

About Me

A closer look at the person behind the portfolio, the experience I have developed, and the kind of work I enjoy doing.

Who I Am

I am a responsible and creative professional who enjoys writing, using social media, editing videos, and creating digital content. My background in Agroforestry also developed my interest and experience in working with nature and the environment.

My experience in journalism and as an Editor-in-Chief strengthened my writing, editing, communication, leadership, and teamwork skills. I enjoy learning new software and digital tools and using them to turn ideas into clear and engaging content.

How I Work

I take initiative, pay attention to details, and approach new tasks with a willingness to learn. I value responsible work, creativity, clear communication, and collaboration with others.
